name: whiteboards
description: Hand-drawn-style whiteboards: Excalidraw scenes saved on your drives, indexed and searchable, with version history and full AI tooling — the assistant can draw and edit boards live.
help: Whiteboards are Excalidraw scenes that live on your drives like files: they are indexed and searchable, keep a full version history with diff and restore, and can be drawn on by hand or by the AI.
When the module is first enabled a 'My Whiteboards' drive is created, but you can create boards in any drive that is not read-only.
While a board is open and the AI edits it, the changes appear live. Every AI edit is a single restorable history entry per answer.
